name: Maddox Ranch House Center-Cut Filet Mignon & Throwback Crown Turkey Steak
brandOrRestaurant: Maddox Ranch House (Perry / Brigham City — Hwy 89 to Logan & Bear Lake)
whyItWorks: Never wrapped in fatty bacon, Maddox's center-cut beef filet mignon and grilled Crown Turkey Steak are ultra-lean, zero-fiber proteins.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Filet Mignon, Tender Roast Beef, or Crown Turkey Steak with a plain baked potato (eat the fluffy inside) and warm dinner rolls.
watchOuts: Skip the raw green salad starter and fried shrimp
